values.name: residential_rental_recovery_years
values.source: IRC 168(c) residential rental property 27.5-year recovery period, straight line, 168(d)(2) mid-month convention; IRS Pub. 946 Table A-6 (all filing statuses) (statutory, not indexed; recalled from the statute, not re-checked against the primary source -- owner/tax-preparer checkpoint WP12.1)

values.name: passive_rental_special_allowance
values.source: IRC 469(i)(2)-(3) as enacted by TRA 1986 (P.L. 99-514): $25,000 rental real estate active-participation allowance, reduced by 50% of MAGI over $100,000; Form 8582 Part II (Single and HOH use these MFJ rows) (statutory, not indexed; recalled from the statute, not re-checked against the primary source -- owner/tax-preparer checkpoint WP12.1)

values.name: passive_rental_special_allowance
values.source: IRC 469(i)(5)(A) (married filing separately, lived apart from spouse all year): $12,500 allowance, phase-out from $50,000; Form 8582 Part II (statutory, not indexed; recalled from the statute, not re-checked against the primary source -- owner/tax-preparer checkpoint WP12.1)

values.name: passive_rental_phaseout_start
values.source: IRC 469(i)(2)-(3) as enacted by TRA 1986 (P.L. 99-514): $25,000 rental real estate active-participation allowance, reduced by 50% of MAGI over $100,000; Form 8582 Part II (Single and HOH use these MFJ rows) (statutory, not indexed; recalled from the statute, not re-checked against the primary source -- owner/tax-preparer checkpoint WP12.1)

values.name: passive_rental_phaseout_start
values.source: IRC 469(i)(5)(A) (married filing separately, lived apart from spouse all year): $12,500 allowance, phase-out from $50,000; Form 8582 Part II (statutory, not indexed; recalled from the statute, not re-checked against the primary source -- owner/tax-preparer checkpoint WP12.1)

values.name: passive_rental_phaseout_rate
values.source: IRC 469(i)(2)-(3) as enacted by TRA 1986 (P.L. 99-514): $25,000 rental real estate active-participation allowance, reduced by 50% of MAGI over $100,000; Form 8582 Part II (all filing statuses) (statutory, not indexed; recalled from the statute, not re-checked against the primary source -- owner/tax-preparer checkpoint WP12.1)

values.name: passive_rental_special_allowance_mfs_not_living_apart
values.source: IRC 469(i)(5)(B): no allowance for a married-filing-separately taxpayer who lived with the spouse at any time during the year (statutory, not indexed; recalled from the statute, not re-checked against the primary source -- owner/tax-preparer checkpoint WP12.1)

values.name: unrecaptured_1250_max_rate
values.source: IRC 1(h)(1)(E) and 1(h)(6) as amended by TRA 1997 (P.L. 105-34): unrecaptured section 1250 gain taxed at ordinary rates capped at 25% (all filing statuses) (statutory, not indexed; recalled from the statute, not re-checked against the primary source -- owner/tax-preparer checkpoint WP12.1)
